steps.title: From interest to meeting — <accent>in 3 steps.</accent>
steps.text: No complicated registrations or extra actions. Choose an event — we simplified the rest.

1.title: Discover an event
1.text: Explore the schedule, filter forums by topic and pick what interests you.

2.title: Get your ticket online
2.text: Choose a ticket category, fill in your details and pay in a convenient way.

3.title: Receive your QR code
3.text: The ticket arrives in Telegram and in your account. Show the QR code at the entrance.

organizers.text: Publish events, sell tickets and manage attendees. Everything for a great event — in one platform.

faq.title: Still have questions
faq.text: We collected answers to the most important ones. And if a question remains, our team will help.

1.q: How do I get my ticket after payment?
1.a: An electronic ticket with a QR code will be available in Telegram and in your account once the payment is confirmed.

2.q: Do I need to print the QR code?
2.a: No. Just show the QR code on your phone screen at the entrance and staff will scan it.

3.q: How can an organizer publish a forum?
3.a: Email us — we will help you create the event, set up ticket categories and open sales.

4.q: Which languages does the platform support?
4.a: The platform is available in Russian, Kyrgyz and English. You can switch the language in the site header.

footer.tagline: A new gathering point for those who create the future of Kyrgyzstan.
